The "Passive_Entry_Menu" PROXI parameter is used to show or hide the "Passive Entry" menu item.
The "Remote_Door_Unlock _Menu" PROXI parameter is used to show or hide the "Remote Door Unlock" menu item.
The "Sound_Horn_Remote_Start _Menu" PROXI parameter is used to show or hide the "Sound Horn Remote Start" menu item.
The "Horn_Chirp_Menù" PROXI parameter is used to show or hide the "Sound Horn With Lock" menu item (if Model_Year<20) OR "Sound Horn with Lock Unlock" menu item (if Model_Year>=20)
The "Flash_Light_With_Lock_Menu" PROXI parameter is used to show or hide the "Flash Light with Lock" menu item.
The " Tyre_Pressure_Unit_Menu "PROXI parameter is used to show or hide the "Tyre Pressure" menu item.
The "CAN node 24 (PAM) " PROXI parameter is used to detect the presence the "Park Assist Module"
The " Side_Distance_Warning "PROXI parameter is used to show or hide the " Side Distance Warning " menu item.
The "PAM_Configuration" PROXI parameter is used to show or hide the "Park Assist Module" menu item.
The "Auto_Door_Unlock_Menu" PROXI parameter is used to show or hide the "Auto Door Unlock On Exit" menu item.
The " Half_HMI_Setting " PROXI parameter is used to show or hide the " LDW Intensity" menu item.
The " Half_Torque_Sensibility " PROXI parameter is used to show or hide the " LDW Sensibility" menu item.
The " AHBM_Feature_Menu " PROXI parameter is used to show or hide the " Auto High Beam Menu" menu item.
The "NAV_Presence" PROXI parameter identifies the presence of Navigation functionalities
The " Ambient_Lighting_Function" PROXI parameter is used to show or hide the "Interior Ambient Light" menu item.
The " Ambient_Dimmer_Switch" PROXI parameter is used to show or hide the " Interior Ambient Light" menu item.
The "Brand_Configuration_2" PROXI parameter is used to show or hide the "Headlights Off Delay" menu item.
